name: source-cli
title: Check portable source and real CLI paths

name: cli-distribution
title: Check complete standalone CLI distribution
run:
cargo build -p nvwa-cli --locked --offline
python3 -B scripts/test-cli-package.py --binary target/debug/nvwa-cli
python3 -B -O scripts/test-cli-package.py --binary target/debug/nvwa-cli

name: b1-inputs
title: Verify admitted production character inputs and source
run:
python3 -B scripts/verify-b1-inputs.py
python3 -B -O scripts/verify-b1-inputs.py
python3 -B scripts/test-b1-inputs.py
python3 -B -O scripts/test-b1-inputs.py

name: motion-comparator
title: Check independent B1 motion comparator controls

name: appearance
title: Check bounded appearance diagnostic controls
run:
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s experiments/65-b1-appearance-quality -p 'test_*.py' -v
python3 -B -O -m unittest discover -s experiments/65-b1-appearance-quality -p 'test_*.py' -v

name: eye-hair-parameters
title: Check eye, hair, and character parameter controls
run:
# The transfer tests run the actual experimental HTML handlers in
# Node. A missing interpreter is an error, never a skipped green test.
node --version
for experiment in 67-b1-eye-surface-diagnosis 68-b1-eye-render-diagnosis 69-b1-hairline 71-b1-character-parameters 72-b1-admission-controls 73-high-poly-eyes 79-shoulder-pose-corrective 79-shoulder-pose-corrective/browser 80-hairline-export-diagnosis 82-hairline-aba; do
  python3 -B -m unittest discover -s "experiments/$experiment" -p 'test_*.py' -v
  python3 -B -O -m unittest discover -s "experiments/$experiment" -p 'test_*.py' -v
done

name: authenticated-source
title: Check authenticated B1 source bundle and rejection controls
run:
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s experiments/59-b1-ci-inputs -p 'test_*.py' -v
python3 -B -O -m unittest discover -s experiments/59-b1-ci-inputs -p 'test_*.py' -v
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s experiments/57-b1-pose-runtime -p 'test_prepare_ci.py' -v
python3 -B -O -m unittest discover -s experiments/57-b1-pose-runtime -p 'test_prepare_ci.py' -v
python3 -B experiments/59-b1-ci-inputs/prepare_ci_inputs.py --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/nvwa-b1-portable-seed"
python3 -B experiments/57-b1-pose-runtime/prepare.py --ci-inputs "$RUNNER_TEMP/nvwa-b1-portable-seed"
python3 -B experiments/58-b1-desktop-web/prepare.py --ci-inputs "$RUNNER_TEMP/nvwa-b1-portable-seed"
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s experiments/58-b1-desktop-web -p 'test_*.py' -v
python3 -B -O -m unittest discover -s experiments/58-b1-desktop-web -p 'test_*.py' -v

python3 -B -O experiments/46-soma-reference-calibration/independent/test_controls.py

name: shoulder-rest-refit
title: Check isolated shoulder rest-refit controls
run:
cargo fmt --manifest-path experiments/84-shoulder-rest-refit/replay/Cargo.toml --package nvwa-shoulder-rest-replay --check
cargo fmt --manifest-path experiments/84-shoulder-rest-refit/wasm-replay/Cargo.toml --package nvwa-shoulder-wasm-replay --check
for part in replay evaluation authoring wasm-replay; do
  python3 -B -m unittest discover -s "experiments/84-shoulder-rest-refit/$part" -p 'test_*.py' -v
  python3 -B -O -m unittest discover -s "experiments/84-shoulder-rest-refit/$part" -p 'test_*.py' -v
done

name: frozen-upper-arm
title: Check frozen upper-arm comparison and retained runtime captures
run:
python3 -B experiments/50-upper-arm-neutral-ab/test_candidate.py
python3 -B -O experiments/50-upper-arm-neutral-ab/test_candidate.py
python3 -B experiments/50-upper-arm-neutral-ab/test_runtime_adapter.py
python3 -B -O experiments/50-upper-arm-neutral-ab/test_runtime_adapter.py
python3 -B experiments/50-upper-arm-neutral-ab/test_runtime_measure.py
python3 -B -O experiments/50-upper-arm-neutral-ab/test_runtime_measure.py
python3 -B experiments/50-upper-arm-neutral-ab/runtime_evidence.py
mkdir -p .work/ci-neutral50
for platform in native web; do
  for variant in baseline candidate; do
    python3 -B experiments/50-upper-arm-neutral-ab/probe/compare.py "experiments/50-upper-arm-neutral-ab/results/$platform-$variant.json" --variant "$variant" --output ".work/ci-neutral50/$platform-$variant.json"
  done
done
